terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: RealSync backend API (Express + BullMQ workers) on http://localhost:8080
terminals.command: cd backend && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci; } && NODE_ENV=development PORT=8080 DATABASE_URL="postgresql://realsync:realsync_local_secret@localhost:5432/realsync_dev" REDIS_URL="redis://127.0.0.1:6379" JWT_SECRET="local_dev_jwt_secret_change_in_production_min32" JWT_REFRESH_SECRET="local_dev_refresh_secret_change_in_production_min32" AGENT_INTERNAL_KEY="local_dev_agent_key" GATEWAY_SECRET="local_dev_gateway_secret" INTERNAL_HEALTH_KEY="local_dev_health_key" ENABLE_WORKERS="true" LOG_LEVEL="info" OPENCLAW_URL="http://127.0.0.1:8443" COMPANY_NAME="RealSync Dynamics" APP_URL="http://localhost:8080" npm run dev

terminals.name: gateway
terminals.description: OpenClaw gateway (Express + WebSocket remote execution) on http://localhost:8443
terminals.command: cd gateway && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci; } && NODE_ENV=development PORT=8443 GATEWAY_API_KEY="local_dev_gateway_api_key_min_32_chars_xx" GATEWAY_ID="gateway-dev-01" BACKEND_URL="http://127.0.0.1:8080" AGENT_INTERNAL_KEY="local_dev_agent_key" REDIS_URL="redis://127.0.0.1:6379" LOG_LEVEL="info" npm run dev
